name: @dsh-external/dotdsh-lazy-ssh
description: dotdsh lazy ssh: one ssh_run tool that keeps an OpenSSH multiplexed connection to each server alive for an idle timeout, so a burst of remote commands pays the TCP handshake and the key exchange once and reuses the rest

scripts.test: pnpm build && node test/verify-pool.mjs && node test/verify-tool.mjs
